confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Granada and comparable Andalusian cities, not live price checks. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is most uncertain because July demand around the Alhambra can move hotel and hostel rates a lot. Wine and cocktail prices are based on the typical Spanish bar price relationship to beer, not direct observation. The FX observation (15 Oct 2026) comes from search-result summaries of RBA pages that I did not open directly; a 16 Oct value was also reported but not verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Andalusian tourist cities with similar summer demand and pricing (Seville, Malaga, Cordoba), adjusted for Granada's lower price level relative to Seville and Malaga.
